study: Greenleaf et al. 2011, Reading Apprenticeship in Biology RCT, AERJ 48(3) / NSF final report
eval_evidence: RCT conducted/authored by WestEd's Strategic Literacy Initiative (the developers of Reading Apprenticeship) with UCLA/CRESST as analytic partner; developers have a clear stake.
developer_evidence: Reading Apprenticeship PD designed and delivered by the Strategic Literacy Initiative (WestEd) team / SLI professional-development facilitators and coaches.
cascade_evidence: SLI facilitators delivered the institutes/training to the biology teachers directly; no train-the-trainer intermediary between SLI and the participating teachers.
counterfactual_evidence: Wait-listed control schools represent a treatment-as-usual condition (no alternative PD); randomization within matched pairs to minimize contamination.
coaching_evidence: Intervention = ~10 days of summer institutes + follow-up training days across two summers/school year; no recurring in-class coaching cycles in teachers' own classrooms (the 'in-class support' captured was teacher-reported instruction, not coach visits).
student_dose_evidence: Changes the high-school biology teacher's own instruction (literacy routines integrated into biology); no student tutoring, pull-out, or added dose.
maturity_evidence: Two-year program (PD across two summers + school years); extracted headline outcomes are end of Year 2 (2006/07), after a prior implementation year.
